name: Nano
tagline: A digital payment protocol designed to be accessible and lightweight, with a focus on removing inefficiencies present in other cryptocurrencies. With ultrafast transactions and zero fees on a secure, green and decentralized network, this makes Nano ideal for everyday transactions.
description: Nano is a digital payment protocol designed to be accessible and lightweight, with a focus on removing inefficiencies present in other cryptocurrencies. With ultrafast transactions and zero fees on a secure, green and decentralized network, this makes Nano ideal for everyday transactions.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/nano:21.2.20220522@sha256:abba1dc5b14d99b1996a52b51d51f9247deea6f2c540d030c02060ea46491843
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      PEER_HOST: ''
      LIVE_GENESIS_PUB: ''
      LIVE_GENESIS_ACCOUNT: ''
      LIVE_GENESIS_WORK: ''
      LIVE_GENESIS_SIG: ''
      CLI_OPTIONS: ''
      LMDB_BOOTSTRAP_URL: ''
    ports:
      - target: 8075
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 7076
        published: 3000
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 7077
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
